nesnd_jp_mining_reason.zh: 北方的矿山与林场为德川氏提供了兴办工业的根基。铁矿、煤炭和木材沿着商路进入工场，才能变成更好的工具和新式武备。军府需要鼓励这门生意，使矿业能够长期供养正在成长的制造业。
nesnd_jp_mining_reason.en: The mines and forests of the north give the Tokugawa a foundation for industry. Iron, coal and timber must reach the workshops before they can become better tools and modern weapons. The government must encourage this trade so that the mines can sustain a growing manufacturing sector.

nesnd_jp_arsenals_reason.zh: 军队需要枪炮，沿海交通和海防需要船只。矿石经过钢厂冶炼，再由工具厂、兵工厂和船坞加工，才能成为国家可以依靠的力量。稳定的订单将使工匠和商人敢于扩建这些工场。
nesnd_jp_arsenals_reason.en: Armies need weapons, while coastal trade and defence depend on ships. Ore must pass through steelworks, tool workshops, arsenals and shipyards before it can strengthen the country. Steady orders will give craftsmen and merchants reason to expand their works.

nesnd_jp_metal_cities_reason.zh: 铁矿、兵工厂和船坞正在改变北方的城下町。前来谋生的工人需要住房和粮食，新的工场也需要懂得技术的人手。扩大的城市与普及的学校将培养这些人才，使地方的繁荣成为国家长久的力量。
nesnd_jp_metal_cities_reason.en: Mines, arsenals and shipyards are changing the castle towns of the north. Workers arriving in search of wages need homes and food, while new factories need people with technical knowledge. Growing towns and wider schooling can provide these skills and give lasting strength to the country.

nesnd_jp_cash_crops_reason.zh: 棉花、生丝与茶叶已经把乡间的生产同远方的市场联结起来。商人收购原料，农民则越来越关心作物能够卖出怎样的价钱。扩大的工商业将为这些出产寻找销路，也使土地上的劳动获得新的用途。
nesnd_jp_cash_crops_reason.en: Cotton, raw silk and tea connect rural production with distant markets. Merchants buy the produce, while farmers pay closer attention to the prices their crops command. Growing commerce and industry can find new buyers and new uses for the work of the countryside.

nesnd_jp_textiles_reason.zh: 棉花和生丝经商人之手运往各地，纺织业也因此有了扩张的余地。更多原料可以留在本国加工，熟练的织工则能带着自己的手艺进入更大的工场。这门生意将给离开田地的人们提供另一种生计。
nesnd_jp_textiles_reason.en: Merchants carry cotton and raw silk to markets near and far, creating room for the textile industry to expand. More of this produce can be processed at home, with skilled weavers bringing their craft into larger mills. The industry can offer another livelihood to people leaving the fields.

nesnd_jp_consumer_goods_reason.zh: 有了稳定的收入，工人和店主便会购买更好的食品、家具和日用器皿。工商业的兴盛需要这许多普通人参与其中，让家庭的开支养活更多工场，也让工场的工资回到市面。
nesnd_jp_consumer_goods_reason.en: With steady incomes, workers and shopkeepers can buy better food, furniture and household goods. Their spending sustains new workshops, whose wages in turn support the shops. A wider market for everyday goods will give industry roots throughout the country.

nesnd_jp_living_standards_reason.zh: 新工场已经吸引人们离开乡村，城市也因他们的劳动而兴旺。政府许诺的繁荣，应当见于百姓的衣食与居所。学校将为他们的子女打开新的道路，而长久改善的生活才能使这些家庭在城市中安顿下来。
nesnd_jp_living_standards_reason.en: New workshops have drawn people from the countryside, and their labour has helped the towns prosper. The prosperity promised by the government should be visible in their food, clothing and homes. Schools can open new paths for their children, while lasting improvements in daily life allow these families to settle in the towns.

nesnd_jp_food_supply_reason.zh: 城里的居民依靠田间、海上和商船送来的粮食生活。丰收与贸易可以共同充实市场，让人们买得起一日所需。稳定的供给也使工匠和工人能够留在城镇，为更多产业谋求生计。
nesnd_jp_food_supply_reason.en: Townspeople depend on food brought from the fields, the sea and merchant ships. Harvests and trade can together keep markets supplied and daily necessities within reach. Reliable food supplies also allow craftsmen and workers to remain in the towns and make their living in new industries.

nesnd_jp_food_cities_reason.zh: 粮食供应安定之后，更多人能够在城镇中靠手艺和买卖生活。商人、学徒和工匠的子女需要学校，官府与书市则不断扩大对纸张的需求。这些城市将把地方的物产与人力聚集起来，成为工商发展的根基。
nesnd_jp_food_cities_reason.en: With reliable food supplies, more people can earn a living through crafts and trade. The children of merchants and craftsmen need schools, while public offices and booksellers create a growing demand for paper. These towns can bring local produce and labour together to support further industry.

nesnd_jp_food_processing_reason.zh: 城镇人口的增长扩大了对加工食品的需求。新的保存方法能够让粮食与鱼获运到更远的市场，供养更多脱离田地的劳动者。商人和工场将从这门生意中获得收入，城市也因此有了更稳固的经济基础。
nesnd_jp_food_processing_reason.en: Growing towns need more processed food. New preservation methods allow grain and fish to reach more distant markets and support more workers away from the land. Merchants and factories can profit from this trade, giving the towns a firmer economic foundation.

nesnd_jp_living_year.zh: 已连续 #v 12#! 个月达到生活水平、学校和城市目标
nesnd_jp_living_year.en: The living standard, school and urban development goals have been met for #v 12#! consecutive months

nesnd_jp_cohesion_reason.zh: 幕府治下的诸藩、乡间的宗族和城下町的商人，曾各自维持着一方秩序。学校与官府把远近的地方联结起来，繁荣的工商业又使更多人的生活休戚相关。百姓能否过得安定，国家能否在战争中保护他们，都在改变人们对共同前途的信心。
nesnd_jp_cohesion_reason.en: The domains of the shogunate, rural clans and merchants of the castle towns once upheld their own local orders. Schools and public administration connect distant communities, while flourishing commerce ties more livelihoods together. Security at home and the country’s fortunes in war shape confidence in a shared future.

nesnd_jp_cohesion_doubt.zh: 民众对政府失去信任，地方分歧正在扩大。
nesnd_jp_cohesion_doubt.en: Public trust in the government is faltering, and local divisions are deepening.

nesnd_jp_cohesion_calm.zh: 各地仍能维持共同的秩序。
nesnd_jp_cohesion_calm.en: The regions continue to uphold a common political order.

nesnd_jp_cohesion_confident.zh:
国民对共同前途的信心正在促进文化融合。
每月有 #v 30%#! 的概率，在一个合格的本国[concept_state]中，使至多相当于该州总人口 #v 10%#! 的人口同化为[GetCulture('japanese').GetName]文化；宗教不变。
nesnd_jp_cohesion_confident.en:
Confidence in a shared future encourages cultural assimilation.
Each month, there is a #v 30%#! chance for people in one eligible owned [concept_state] to adopt [GetCulture('japanese').GetName] culture, up to #v 10%#! of that state's total population. Religion remains unchanged.
